reference_scope: partition-names-only; no physical-layout or ArtisanROM-equivalence claim
requires: The pinned ExtremeROM repartitioner is used only as a reference for generic partition names. Its size values and repartition/cleaner operations are not used. This is not proof of the SM-G975F physical layout or ArtisanROM compatibility. The existing S10 TWRP payload format is retained; no ExtremeROM image-format claim is made. No fixed image-size limits; check actual capacity read-only before writes. No repartitioning or formatting.
